name: Order Status
description: User wants to check the status of an existing order.
response_template: I'd be happy to help you check your order status. Could you please provide your order number?

name: Return Request
description: User wants to initiate a return or exchange.
response_template: I can help you with a return. Our return policy allows returns within 30 days of delivery. Could you share your order number and the item you'd like to return?

name: Shipping Information
description: User has questions about shipping times, costs, or options.
response_template: We offer standard (5-7 business days), express (2-3 business days), and overnight shipping. Free shipping on orders over $50!

name: Product Recommendation
description: User is looking for product suggestions based on their needs.
response_template: I'd love to help you find the right product! Could you tell me a bit about what you're looking for and your budget range?

name: Pricing Inquiry
description: User wants to know about pricing, discounts, or payment plans.
response_template: Great question about pricing! Let me walk you through our plans and any current promotions we have available.

name: Refund Policy
description: User asking about the refund process and timeline.
response_template: Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days after we receive the returned item. The refund goes back to the original payment method.

name: Account Issues
description: User needs help with account access, password reset, or profile updates.
response_template: I can help with your account. Are you having trouble logging in, need to update your information, or something else?

name: Getting Started
description: New user needs help with initial setup and configuration.
response_template: Welcome! Let's get you set up. The first step is to complete your profile. Have you verified your email address yet?
